returns._0: USD value (18 decimals) after applying liquidation-threshold discounts.

params.collateralManager_: Address of the CollateralManager that lists whitelisted                             collateral tokens and their risk parameters.
params.feeRecipient_: Address to receive minting fees and stability-fee interest.
params.oracle_: Address of the initial IUSDAxOracle implementation.
params.owner_: Initial contract owner (receives Ownable access control).
params.stabilityFeePerYear_: Annual stability fee in basis points (0–2000, e.g. 500 = 5%).
params.usdax_: Address of the USDAxToken contract. This contract must                             subsequently be registered as its vault engine via                             USDAxToken.updateVaultEngine(address(this)).

currentDebt(address).details: Pure view — does not write state. To persist the interest on-chain, call drip().         Result may differ from `debt[user]` by the pending stability fee.

returns._0: Total outstanding USDAX debt (18 decimals) including accrued but undripped interest.

params.amount: Raw token amount to transfer (token's native decimals). Must be > 0.
params.token: ERC-20 address of the collateral token to deposit. Must be whitelisted.

params.user: The vault owner whose interest should be settled.

returns._0: Array of every address that has ever deposited collateral.

params.collToken: Collateral token address to seize in exchange for the repaid debt.
params.debtToRepay: USDAX (18 decimals) the liquidator wants to repay. Capped internally                    if it exceeds available collateral capacity.
params.vaultOwner: Address of the vault to liquidate. Must not equal msg.sender.

returns._0: Maximum USDAX (18 decimals) mintable in total against current collateral.

params.amount: USDAX to record as new debt (18 decimals). Must be ≥ MIN_DEBT.               Caller receives `amount - mintFee`; the full `amount` enters debt.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingFee(address).details: Equivalent to currentDebt(user) - debt[user]. Returns 0 if fee is zero or         no time has elapsed since last settlement.

returns._0: USD value (18 decimals) at spot prices, undiscounted.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.amount: USDAX to burn (18 decimals). Capped at currentDebt(caller). Must be > 0.

params.ceiling: Maximum outstanding USDAX (18 decimals). 0 = no ceiling.

params.recipient: New address to receive minting fees and stability interest. Must be non-zero.

params.newOracle: Address of the replacement IUSDAxOracle implementation. Must be non-zero.

params.feeBps: New rate in basis points (0–2 000, i.e. 0–20% APY).

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.amount: Raw token amount to withdraw (token's native decimals). Must be > 0.
params.token: ERC-20 address of the collateral token to withdraw.

BASIS_POINTS().notice: Divisor used for all basis-point calculations (10 000 = 100%).

MAX_ORACLE_STALENESS().notice: Maximum acceptable age for oracle prices consumed inside this contract.         VaultEngine validates `updatedAt` independently of the oracle's own check         as defence-in-depth: even a swapped oracle without staleness guards is caught.         2 hours is chosen to tolerate keeper downtime while bounding price risk.

MAX_STABILITY_FEE().notice: Hard cap on the stability fee rate (basis points per year).         2 000 bps = 20% APY. setStabilityFee() reverts above this value.

MINT_FEE_BPS().notice: One-time minting fee charged when USDAX is minted (basis points).         50 bps = 0.5%. Deducted from the amount the borrower receives; the full         `amount` parameter is recorded as debt so the fee is effectively pre-paid.

MIN_DEBT().notice: Minimum USDAX debt required to open or maintain a vault position.         Prevents dust vaults that cannot be economically liquidated.

SECONDS_PER_YEAR().notice: Seconds per year used in linear interest calculations (365 days).

WAD().notice: 1 WAD = 1e18. Used as the fixed-point base for health factor values.         A health factor of exactly 1 WAD means the vault is at the liquidation boundary.

adjustedCollateralValue(address).notice: Total USD value of a vault's collateral, weighted by each token's         liquidation threshold (≤ maxLTV). Used as the numerator in health factor.

collateralDeposits(address,address).notice: Amount of each collateral token held in each user's vault.         collateralDeposits[vaultOwner][collateralToken] = raw token amount.

collateralManager().notice: Registry of whitelisted collateral tokens and their risk parameters.

currentDebt(address).notice: Current total debt for a vault, including interest not yet dripped.

debt(address).notice: Recorded principal debt for each vault owner (18 decimals, denominated in USDAX).         This is the *stored* debt last written by drip(). Pending (undripped) interest         is not included — use currentDebt() for the live value.

debtCeiling().notice: Maximum USDAX (18 decimals) that may be outstanding through this engine.         Compared against usdax.totalSupply() at mint time. 0 = no ceiling.

depositCollateral(address,uint256).notice: Deposit whitelisted collateral into the caller's vault.         The token must be enabled in CollateralManager.         Blocked when the protocol is paused.

drip(address).notice: Settle accrued stability-fee interest for a vault.         Computes linear interest since the last settlement, increases the vault's         recorded debt, mints the fee amount to feeRecipient, and updates         lastDripTime to block.timestamp.         Called automatically by every state-mutating vault action. Safe to call         externally (e.g. by keepers) to keep debt records up to date.

feeRecipient().notice: Address that receives minting fees and accrued stability fees.

getVaultOwners().notice: Enumeration of all vault owner addresses (including those with zero current debt).         Used by the keeper to scan all positions for liquidation eligibility.

healthFactor(address).notice: Health factor for a vault (WAD-scaled).         healthFactor = adjustedCollateralValue × WAD / currentDebt.         Values ≥ WAD (1e18) are healthy; < WAD is liquidatable.         Returns type(uint256).max for zero-debt vaults.

lastDripTime(address).notice: Timestamp of the last drip() settlement for each vault owner.         0 = vault has never had debt; first mint sets this to block.timestamp.

liquidate(address,uint256,address).notice: Liquidate an undercollateralised vault.         The caller burns `debtToRepay` USDAX and receives the equivalent value of         `collToken` plus a liquidation bonus. Blocked when the protocol is paused.         Dust-vault edge case: if available collateral is so small that the fixed-point         division rounds the repayable debt to zero, the engine seizes all remaining         collateral for a nominal 1-wei debt repayment, ensuring dust positions can         always be cleared and never become permanent bad debt.         Partial liquidation: if `collWithBonus` exceeds available collateral the engine         automatically caps `debtToRepay` to the maximum supportable by the available         collateral.

maxMintable(address).notice: Maximum USDAX the caller can mint given current collateral and maxLTV ratios.         The returned value is the total LTV capacity; subtract currentDebt(user) to         get the remaining headroom.

mintUsdax(uint256).notice: Mint USDAX against the caller's deposited collateral.         Blocked when the protocol is paused.         Fee mechanics: `amount` is recorded as new debt. The caller receives         `amount - fee` USDAX; `fee` (0.5% of `amount`) is minted to feeRecipient.         The debt ceiling (if set) is checked against total supply before minting.         Pending stability-fee interest is settled first so the LTV check is exact.

oracle().notice: Active price oracle. Can be replaced via setOracle() to upgrade feeds.

pause().notice: Pause the protocol. Blocks depositCollateral, mintUsdax, and liquidate.         repayUsdax and withdrawCollateral remain available so users can always exit.         Only callable by the contract owner.

pendingFee(address).notice: Stability-fee interest accrued for a vault since the last drip.

rawCollateralValue(address).notice: Raw USD value of a vault's collateral at current oracle prices,         without any risk discount applied.

repayUsdax(uint256).notice: Repay USDAX debt for the caller's vault.         Intentionally NOT paused — users must always be able to reduce or clear         their debt regardless of protocol state.         If `amount` exceeds outstanding debt the repayment is capped at the debt.

setDebtCeiling(uint256).notice: Set the global USDAX debt ceiling.         Only callable by the contract owner (or timelock on production).

setFeeRecipient(address).notice: Update the fee recipient address.         Only callable by the contract owner (or timelock on production).

setOracle(address).notice: Replace the active price oracle.         The new oracle must implement IUSDAxOracle. All subsequent price reads         will use the new oracle immediately. Emits OracleUpdated.         Only callable by the contract owner (or timelock on production).

setStabilityFee(uint256).notice: Set the annual stability fee rate.         Only callable by the contract owner (or timelock on production).

stabilityFeePerYear().notice: Annual stability fee rate in basis points (e.g. 500 = 5% APY).         Applied continuously to outstanding vault debt. 0 = no fee.

unpause().notice: Unpause the protocol, restoring all blocked operations.         Only callable by the contract owner.

usdax().notice: The USDAX stablecoin token. Only this contract may mint or burn.

withdrawCollateral(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw collateral from the caller's vault.         Intentionally NOT paused — users must always be able to reclaim collateral         after repaying debt.         If the caller still has outstanding debt, the post-withdrawal health factor         must remain ≥ 1.05 (a 5% buffer above the liquidation threshold).
